source.quote: a big problem i always had with enocian was that it was using English letters, and ed Kelley was a shyster who knew kabbala. The first paper I wrote, "Across the Eras" (before i knew a lot about what io know now) nievely but still following my intuition, thought the key to SOMETHING was the "AHH" or "AUM" sound. then when i learned about kabbala and the names i thought i was on the right track. thinking about my theory about sound preceeding light in the universe, and a thought ive had since i was a kid regarding magic and "secret passwords" (and watching aladdin as a kid. abracababra) i always thougnt that if maagic was actually real that it was in a large part accomplished through sound, the correct sounds. then, im not sure where i heard it, definitely in more places than one, "Language itself has become a curse" that hit close to home for some reason. then when studying for the book series im writing, the doves, (all fiction. think da vinci code with magic. with gutenberg gambit hiding recipe to ambrosia/the philosopher's stone in the worlds first printed books and tarot cards, the voynich vendetta, the somertan someritan, the oxford occultist* {shakespeare creating english-for the most part}, the tibetan BOD, and the Medici dilemma) which is how i fell into all this in the first place, but now i feel responsible to be as accurate as possible and in some ways barely care about the books anymore, just truth. all of this is to point out that if it has to do with sounds, i suspect it would be in languages closest to the source. phoenician, sumerian, ancient hebrew, acadian, aramaic...not a language that had only been around for 200 years before dee.
